# Locked dependency set for the build, test, lint and release toolchain.
#
# Direct versions come from the pinned dev group and build backend in
# pyproject.toml:
#
#   build==1.6.1  coverage==7.17.5  mypy==2.4.1
#   pyyaml==6.0.4  ruff==0.17.6  twine==7.0.0  hatchling==1.33.0
#
# pyyaml is a CI-only dependency: bin/check_workflows.py validates the workflows
# with a duplicate-rejecting loader, which is what catches a step that defines
# `shell`/`env`/`run` twice.
#
# pip-audit is added because it is the scanner used to verify this lock has no
# known vulnerabilities (advisory data: OSV.dev). The remaining entries are the
# transitive closure of the set above.
#
# The published package declares no runtime dependencies, so there is no runtime
# graph to lock here; this pins everything that builds, checks and publishes it.
#
# Every entry uses == and carries the sha256 digests PyPI publishes for that
# version across every distribution file, so the lock verifies on any platform:
#
#   pip install -c constraints.txt build coverage mypy pyyaml ruff twine pip-audit
#
# For a strictly hash-enforced install, put these in a requirements file:
#
#   -c constraints.txt
#   build
#   coverage
#   mypy
#   pyyaml
#   ruff
#   twine
#   pip-audit
#
# and install it with: pip install --require-hashes -r <that file>
#
# Regenerate by resolving the graph again and re-reading each pin sha256 from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json
#
# Verify with:
#   python -m pip_audit --progress-spinner off
